items.title: Pete Jolly interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Al Cohn, Billy Byers, Charlie Barnet, Quincy Jones even led a thing. Yeah, this is 1955. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah ’55.

ctx.x: Well that was Jack again. He wanted all the artists to do a version of “Lullaby of Birdland.” That’s what he did. So when he came out he says, “Well I want you to do a version of “Lullaby of Birdland” I said, “Well why?” He said, “Well I’m going to do this album with various artists. I forgot all the artists on there, but there’s Al Cohn I think—
Al Cohn, Billy Byers, Charlie Barnet, Quincy Jones even led a thing. Yeah, this is 1955.
Yeah ’55. That’s when everything started to happen, where I got recognition. MR. Right.
